content.short: BoomFi is an all-in-one crypto payment platform enabling businesses to send, accept, and convert crypto payments across multiple blockchains.
content.description: BoomFi is a comprehensive crypto payments infrastructure platform enabling businesses and individuals to send, accept, and convert cryptocurrency payments across multiple blockchain networks, supporting subscription payments, one-time invoices, and automated payroll in crypto. The platform is built for Web3-native businesses seeking reliable, multi-chain payment rails. BoomFi's integration with Mantle allows merchants to accept Mantle-based assets as payment seamlessly.
content.meta: BoomFi is an all-in-one crypto payment platform for sending and accepting payments on Mantle and multiple chains. Discover BoomFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
